system.description: Blood magic comes instinctively to you. Whenever you taste blood, you automatically glean one fact about its source exactly as the Basic Path of Blood power A Taste for Blood, with no blood cost or test required. You may still invoke the actual Discipline power for more detailed results, which supersede this Merit's automatic information. The sensitivity cannot be turned off, and it isn't always pleasant — unusual, fearful, or poisoned vitae can cause nausea or worse at the Storyteller's discretion.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
